title: Minister visits Northland
content:
13 July 2004

Minister visits Northland

  • Damien O'Connor
Health

Associate Health Minister and Minister responsible for rural health, Damien O'Connor, will be in Northland next week.

Mr O'Connor's two-day trip will include visits to a range of local health providers, including PHOs in the Hokianga and Kaikohe, health trusts, and the Mobile Dental Clinic in Paihia.

He'll also meet with the two local Rural Nurse Scholarship recipients.

Mr O'Connor said he was looking forward to the visit.

"There are several issues facing rural health providers nationwide and I think it's important to discuss them with the people at the coal face," he said.

"There's a large and varied range of providers in Northland and I'll be interested to hear each of their perspectives."

Mr O'Connor's schedule is as follows:

Monday 12th July

8.30-10.00 GP Workforce & Education Support
Northern Rural General Practice Consortium , Kerikeri.

10.30-11.00Rural Oral Health
Visit Mobile Dental Clinic in Paihia

11.30- 3.30Hauora Whanui Offices Kawakawa

Official Welcome and Lunch

Rural Nursing

Nurse Integration Leader, Te Tai Tokerau PHO

Adrienne Murray, Rural Nurse Scholarship winner and member of staff at Te Haurora O Te Hiku O Te Ika, Kaitaia

Raiha Mathews, Rural Nurse Scholarship winner and member of staff of Kaitaia Hospital

Maori, Nursing and Allied Health Workforce Support and Education

Northern Rural Nursing & Allied Health Professionals Consortium

Maori Workforce Consortium

Rural Primary Health Organisation

Te Tai Tokerau PHO, and GP’s

Whangaroa PHO and GP’s ( PHO Governance Board consists of two members each from Te Runanga O Whangaroa and Whangaroa Health Service Trust a Primary Care Organisation in Kaeo )

4.45 – 6.00Integrated Primary Health Organisation and Primary Care Organisation

Hokianga Health Enterprise Trust. and Hauora Hokianga Integrated PHO

12.00 – 1.30Lunch
